_readme: Second own-site map read at College of the Canyons (S346, SkyCairn). Its mapper (canyons.programmapper.ws) answered 403 on 2026-10-04, and S345 found that its department pages' 'recommended course sequence documents' link into the mapper. A domain-restricted search (2026-10-08) found department PDFs on www.canyons.edu itself: the Digital Media Studies GE-track program map (2025-26, nine terms with units), an Interior Design roadmap and a Kinesiology pathway template, with no central index. This read loads the Digital Media Studies map, to learn the shape of a department-posted map.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map off its refused mapper host, and in what form.
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses.
